reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Bias, stereotypes and cultural diversity
themes.definition: AI reproducing bias, prejudice, hate or stereotypes, distorting or censoring history, misrepresenting peoples, and threatening or protecting linguistic and cultural diversity.
themes.inclusion: Passages on biased training data, discrimination, AI spreading hatred or stereotypes, digital erasure of non-hegemonic cultures, fair representation in AI-mediated knowledge, preserving small languages or multilingualism.
themes.exclusion: General human rights or ethics language without bias or cultural content (AI_HUMAN_RIGHTS_ETHICS); disinformation campaigns (AI_DISINFORMATION).
themes.boundary_cases: AI used to protect small languages (a positive application) is coded here because the concern is cultural diversity.

examples.quote: Misuse of AI is sharpening bias and diluting mutual respect.

themes.label: Capacity building and AI cooperation
themes.definition: Concrete cooperation to build AI capabilities: skills, training, technology transfer, financing, infrastructure, regional AI centres and bilateral or South-South AI partnerships.
themes.inclusion: Passages offering or requesting AI training, funds, compute, infrastructure, knowledge sharing, regional centres or partnerships.
themes.exclusion: Statements of inequality without a support measure (AI_DIGITAL_DIVIDE); a country's own domestic programmes (AI_NATIONAL_STRATEGY).
themes.boundary_cases: A country offering its national AI experience to others takes this code and AI_NATIONAL_STRATEGY.

examples.quote: AI will be very much part of a partnership agenda with the global South.

themes.label: AI listed among technologies
themes.definition: AI named only briefly in a neutral or positive list of technologies, trends or national strengths, without further discussion of AI itself.
themes.inclusion: Passages where 'artificial intelligence' appears alongside other technologies (robotics, big data, quantum, biotech) with no AI-specific claim.
themes.exclusion: AI listed among threats or crises (AI_THREAT_LIST_MENTION); any passage with an AI-specific claim (use the substantive code).
themes.boundary_cases: A list plus one AI-specific sentence should receive the substantive code instead of, or in addition to, this code.

examples.quote: Others focus on new concerns, such as the responsible harnessing of artificial intelligence.

value.rationale: Consolidated 3 proposals into 3 codes of a shared multilabel codebook. Merged: AI_MISUSE_BIAS -> AI_BIAS_CULTURAL_DIVERSITY (1). Distinct minority concepts are kept as separate codes (e.g. governance scepticism, inclusive rule-making, resource footprint, bias and cultural diversity, peace applications). Mention is not endorsement.
